prompt: What is 'elitism' in the context of genetic algorithms?
choices: Giving the fittest individuals extra mutation chances
Automatically carrying the best individual(s) unchanged into the next generation
Initializing the population with only high-quality individuals
Running the GA only on high-performance hardware
explanation: Elitism guarantees that the best solution found so far is never lost due to crossover/mutation. Typically the top 1-2 individuals are copied directly to the next generation. This ensures monotonic improvement in best-so-far fitness across generations.
